Axis.description:
An axis of an array type, and the kind of unit along it. The values (a recording's 30 kHz, a
slide's 0.25 µm per pixel) come from each result's metadata, never from the type.

unit.description: The kind of unit along it (`time`, `length`), or `None` for a count (channels).

Format.description: How a stored result is encoded (`ome-zarr`, `parquet`, `svg`).

Type.description: A type's name: a shared type (`image`) or an app's (`dspk:sorting`).

description:
A type, described once: what an agent reads to write an op that takes it correctly
([standard §1.5](../../../standard/spec/01-types.md)).

axes.description: For arrays, its axes in order.

formats.description: The formats it can be stored in.

title: TypeDescription
